rules.statement: A sale by a minor is not absolutely void but only voidable at the instance of the minor, provided he seeks restitution or equivalent legal remedy within a certain period after attaining majority.
rules.supporting_quote: "Thus it appears that the Roman-Dutch law is quite in accord with the general principle that a person cannot be judge in his own cause, and that where he wishes to get rid of the effects of his own act he must seek the assistance of the Court."
